pilot: HCC1395 ASM follow-up: count provenance + context TP/FP + methylation measurement + subclone
evaluator: independent fresh-context evaluator (read-only); written by parent agent
overall: PASS-with-caveats; no overclaim across all 3 questions; single-sample + FP-underpower honestly hedged

per_question.q: Q-count: records vs positions; pseudoreplication effect on H-A
per_question.numbers: 56,320 records -> 34,154 positions (TP 30,511 + FP 3,643). truth 39,447, analyzed TP ~30,490 (recall 77%). Pseudoreplication: per-record partial rho=-0.0551 (n=5142) -> per-position -0.0393 (n=5056), inflation 1.017x. only 86/5056 positions had both HP1+HP2 sig. H-A 'ASM not CN-driven' HOLDS (effect shrank, still |rho|<=0.1, opposite sign). Minor 30,490 vs 30,511 = 21-position gap (immaterial).

per_question.q: Q-context: ploidy does not deterministically drive methyl clustering? user's 2 hypotheses?
per_question.verdict: ploidy-independence SUPPORTED (weak/correct sense); H-ctx1 REFUTED+REVERSED; H-ctx2 UNDERPOWERED
per_question.numbers: CN/ploidy does NOT drive methylation |db|/blind_ari (H-A partial rho=-0.039; H-E blind>>placebo p=1.8e-43) BUT CN DOES shift caller TP-rate (gain OR=1.57 p=6.4e-5; loss OR=0.12 p=4.7e-29; LOH main OR=0.36 p=5.3e-20; cov OR=1.004/CpG). H-ctx1 (LOH+abnCN+hi-clust->FP): cell n=84 FP=9, TP-rate 89.3% vs 93.4%, OR=0.59 p=0.18 (ns trend; ARI>=0.3 OR=0.49 p=0.088). REVERSAL: within LOH high-clustering is TP-ENRICHED (OR=2.385 p=0.019; TP blind_ari median 0.258 > FP 0.168 MW p=0.0075); FP concentrate in LOW-clustering LOH-gain. H-ctx2 (nonLOH+hiCov+hi-clust->TP): cell n=25 FP=0, nonLOH total FP=2 -> structurally UNDERPOWERED. C1 sub-q: within LOH abnormal-CN NOT more FP than cnLOH (opposite small: cnLOH 18.8% vs abnormal 17.1%, OR=0.892 p=0.009).

per_question.q: Q-measurement: binarization / 5mC-5hmC collapse / dead-zone bias? subclone implication? adjustment?
per_question.verdict: CONFIRM locus-specific lossy (NOT global bias); subclone NOT confirmed; targeted adjustment recommended
per_question.numbers: Global binarized~continuous r=0.998 (Spearman 0.992) -> not globally biased. Lossy: corr(db_max,5hmC)=0.033 (5hmC orthogonal, discarded by max-collapse); 5hmC>5mC at 12.0% of CpG; deadzone(ML 50-200)=12.5% (44,409/355,765); top-divergent loci div up to 0.13/frac_intermediate up to 0.24 incl BRCA2 (cont beta 0.162 > bin 0.072, frac_int 0.147). Subclone: 43/247 loci bimodal (17.4%), 24/43 = HP-split, 19 subclone-like but 0 blind_ari-confirmed (M2/C2 disjoint sampling, ~15 overlap). BRCA2 UNIMODAL (dBIC=-6.6) = clean ASM not subclone. bimodal TP 17.8% vs FP 12.5% (FP n=16 -> cannot discriminate).

measurement_adjustment_needed: YES targeted (not global). (1) report SEPARATED continuous 5mC + 5hmC beta (max-collapse discards 5hmC, corr 0.033); (2) use continuous (not 0/1) per-read beta at high-frac_intermediate loci (deadzone 12.5%, BRCA2 cont 0.162 > bin 0.072). Scope: ~10 top-divergent loci + 19 subclone-like candidates; re-test per-read GMM on continuous mod-separated beta over the SAME locus set as blind_ari; confirm in COLO829 before any discrete-subclone claim.
subclone_verdict: PREDOMINANTLY_HP_SPLIT — NOT a confirmed discrete methylation subclone. 19 candidates, 0 blind_ari-corroborated; dominant per-read structure = somatic HP subgroup (germ-vs-som split). BRCA2 unimodal (clean ASM). Blocked on 2nd sample.
needs_work: 30,490 (caller TP) vs 30,511 (ASM-eligible positions) = 21-position gap: state, don't silently average.
Do NOT let 'ploidy does not drive clustering' slide into 'CN has no effect' — CN DOES shift caller TP-rate; CN-independence is specifically about methylation |db|/blind_ari, not TP-rate.
H-ctx1 = non-significant directional TREND (p=0.18; 0.088 at ARI>=0.3), 9 in-cell FP so genuinely ns NOT underpowered; report as trend, and note the REVERSAL (hi-clust=TP-enriched within LOH).
H-ctx2 structurally UNDERPOWERED (cell FP=0; nonLOH total FP=2); 100% TP-rate uninformative, never cite as evidence FOR.
Subclone BLOCKED on 2nd sample (0/19 blind_ari-confirmed; M2/C2 disjoint sampling); no candidate above hypothesis tier from HCC1395 alone.
Single-sample ceiling on all 3 answers; tier <=3 until COLO829.
headline: 倍體/CN 不驅動甲基分群結構（clustering 真實且 CN-independent），但 CN 確實影響 caller TP/FP rate（兩者要分開講）。用戶『LOH 內甲基分群=異常拷貝 FP』直覺被反轉：LOH 內高 clustering 反而 TP-enriched，FP 落在低 clustering。甲基測量在特定位點 lossy（5hmC 被丟、intermediate 被壓平），需 targeted 升級為分離連續 5mC+5hmC，subclone 需 COLO829 複製。
